chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Defeats Xia Mang Zishan – The Top Three of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning enters a godlike flow state and crushes Xia Mang Zishan to claim his place among the top three. Now only one can become a Daofather’s disciple—and the final tests loom.
og_title: Ji Ning Enters the Top Three – The Daofather’s Choice Awaits
og_description: After a breathtaking battle that pushes Ji Ning into an unconscious state of sword-perfection, the Immortal Fortunes Assembly’s final three are set. The price of victory: a throne, a master, and destiny itself.
twitter_title: Ji Ning breaks into the top three at the Immortal Fortunes Assembly!
twitter_description: The top three are decided. One will become a Daofather’s disciple. The other two? Pure Yang True Immortals. The final round-robin is coming.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-tier immortal in the Three Realms, second only to Daofathers and above Celestial Immortals; their disciples are considered exceptionally fortunate.
The highest known level of Ki Refiner in the Three Realms, a cultivator who has mastered a Heavenly Dao and holds supreme authority.
A time-acceleration treasure that compresses one month of cultivation into one hour of external time; a classic Xianxia training item.
A recording technique used by the Xia Emperor to capture the three final battles for Daofather Crimsonbright’s review.
A powerful genius of the Lotos clan, Ji Ning’s love interest; her feelings toward Ji Ning shift from romantic hope to quiet blessing as his path diverges from hers.
